datasets.label: Stars within 60 pc (≥ 0.5 M☉)
datasets.description: Full merged Gaia DR3 + Hipparcos catalogue out to 60 pc, limited to stars of at least 0.5 solar masses.

datasets.label: Bright stars — within 120 pc
datasets.description: 120 pc sphere, limited to stars of at least 0.9 solar masses.

datasets.label: All stars within 20 pc
datasets.description: Dense local sample out to 20 pc.

datasets.label: Galactic disc — 1.25 kpc (1.5 M stars)
datasets.description: Gaia DR3 G < 15 within 1250 pc, zero-point-corrected distances, thinned to ~1.5 million stars. Colours corrected for dust reddening (Edenhofer 2024 3D map).

datasets.label: Galactic disc — bright tracers (M_G ≤ 2, 1.3 M stars)
datasets.description: Every Gaia DR3 star within 1250 pc with dust-corrected absolute magnitude M_G ≤ 2: bright enough to be seen through the whole volume at G < 15, so the density shows the disc rather than the survey's magnitude limit. Colours corrected for dust reddening.
